name: gentle-herdr-status
description: Pi extension that shows in the Herdr sidebar the running subagent ($subagent), the orchestrator phase ($phase), the running jobs ($jobs) and the panel name ($name). Pane state and notifications stay with Herdr's official Pi integration.
